weeks.topic: Introduction to African Poetry analysis, and poetic devices.
weeks.content: Study of Gabriel Okara - "Once Upon a Time"; themes, content

Study of Wole Soyinka - "Night"; themes, structure, and poetic
devices.

Study of Niyi Osundare - "Not My Business"; themes, style, tone, and
poetic analysis.

Study of Syl Cheney-Coker - "The Breast of the Sea"; themes, content
analysis, imagery, and symbolism.
Assessment of first half of the term's work.

Study of S.O.H. Afriyie-Vidza - "Hearty Garlands" and Elizabeth L. A.
Kamara - "New Tongue"; themes, mood, tone, and poetic devices.

Study of Maya Angelou - "Still I Rise"; themes of perseverance and
empowerment; poetic techniques.

Study of Lord Byron - "She Walks in Beauty"; themes, diction, mood,
and imagery.

Study of Seamus Heaney - "Digging" and Fleur Adcock - "The Telephone
Call"; structure, tone, and poetic analysis.
General review of all poems studied (African and Non-African).
